create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
get_graph_weights_as_numpy: get graph arc weights as a numpy array using weights_to_numpy for numerical processing
set_graph_weights_from_list: set graph arc weights from a Python list or numpy array using set_weights
run_backward_autograd_on_graph: run backward autograd on a scalar graph result to compute gradients with gtn.backward
negate_add_subtract_scalar_graphs: negate add or subtract scalar graphs using gtn.negate gtn.add and gtn.subtract
